summary.plain: A Japanese-Australian collaboration that ran gamma-ray telescopes in the South Australian outback to study very high energy gamma rays from the southern sky.
summary.technical: CANGAROO (Collaboration of Australia and Nippon for GAmma Ray Observation in the Outback): University of Adelaide with Japanese universities and ICRR; operated the 3.8 m, 7/10 m and four-telescope 10 m (CANGAROO-III) imaging Cherenkov telescopes at Woomera until 2011.
